text:
Carla: starting canary flip to v3.2.0-quant on eu-prod at 10% traffic, embeddings route only. rolling over in 2 min.
deploy-bot: Automated signal: embedding-service: request-error-rate up 4.2% -> suggested action: HOLD or ROLLBACK. details: p95 latency +120ms, 5xx increased. :warning:
Carla: saw that in the dashboard too. not yet 30m sustained but it's trending. holding on the flip. @Megan can you pull logs for worker-embeders?
Megan (oncall): looking now. tailing logs, getting repeated OOMs on embed-worker-3 after ~1.1M tokens. stack shows quantized kernel fallback.
Raj (SRE): that matches the kernel selector changes in this build. quant path falls back to slower kernel, memory footprint spikes. can we repro on staging?
Tony (infra): repro on staging with a shorter trace. I can force same model variant on staging and run load.
Carla: okay, we should decide: 1) full rollback to v3.1.9 on embeddings route, 2) partial pin previous model for embeddings-only, or 3) throttle canary further. thoughts?
Alex (product): customers using embeddings are latency-sensitive. prefer conservative: partial pin for embeddings and keep other routes on 3.2.0-quant if safe. minimize churn for chat paths.
Support: FYI we've had 3 inbound tickets from EU beta customers noticing slower embed times since morning.
Megan (oncall): i've captured heap profiles and traces, will attach to the ticket. short term, manual partial rollback is low-risk.
Carla: agree. Action: manual pin embeddings route to model v3.1.9 (non-quant) in eu-prod while we debug quant kernel selection. we'll leave text-generation on v3.2.0-quant. I'll execute and notify customers.
Raj (SRE): command to run: `redwoodctl rollout set-route --region eu-prod --route embeddings --model v3.1.9 --mode manual --sticky 30m`
Carla: running now: `# redwoodctl rollout set-route ...`
deploy-bot: Rollout command accepted. ChangeID: CID-20260321-944. Traffic shift: embeddings route -> v3.1.9 pinned, change window 30m, autopilot disabled.
Tony (infra): created a canary ticket: INC-embed-944. assigning to me + eng-ml.
Carla: @Support please send a short note to impacted customers: "We've temporarily pinned embeddings in EU to a stable model while we investigate a performance regression in the quantized variant. No data loss; queries will route to the previous model with expected latency improvement." keep it simple.
Support: drafting now, will post to the two affected accounts and the beta cohort.
Megan (oncall): continuing investigation: collecting kernel selection logs, will try a targeted repro with quant flags: `QUANT_KERNEL=2 ./embed_load_test --qsize 1M`
Raj (SRE): plan for next steps: 1) rollback/pin done (done), 2) run staging repro + capture perf counters (in progress), 3) if repro stable, push tiny fix or revert the kernel selector change, 4) run canary again behind throttled traffic.
Carla: timeline: immediate pin (now), update release notes and public changelog later today noting the temporary pin and that a follow-up release will address regression. @Alex please confirm wording for release notes.
Alex (product): will add a short line under "Known Issues": "EU embeddings temporarily routed to v3.1.9 due to a performance regression in v3.2.0-quant. Fix in progress."
deploy-bot: Change CID-20260321-944 -> completed pin at 4447772274. Rollout audit: actor=Carla, method=manual, routes_changed=embeddings.
Carla: excellent. leaving autopilot disabled until SRE+ML signoff. anyone object?
Raj (SRE): no objections. will keep monitoring for any spillover.
Tony (infra): I'll run a canary with instrumented kernels within 2 hours and post results.
Megan (oncall): posting logs & heap dumps to the ticket. I'll also run a short perf baseline vs v3.1.9 and attach numbers.
Support: outbound messages sent to affected customers at 4447772330. template included ETA for follow-up in 4-6 hours.
Carla: thanks team. closing this thread after postmortem doc linked in the ticket. :thumbsup:
